newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Resource Mortgage initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Resource Mortgage initiated.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said it has initiated coverage of Resource Mortgage Capital Inc with an outperform rating for both the intermediate and long-term.

--"We believe that a significant increase in cash dividends, beginning in the first quarter of 1997, will enhance shareholder's current cash returns and result in meaningful price appreciation for Resource Mortgage Capital's common stock," said EVEREN in a report.
--Its six-month price target on the stock is $32.
--Resource Mortgage, a real estate investment trust, was unchanged at 27-5/8.
